title: Stuffing 101
description: A classic stuffing recipe perfect for Thanksgiving and comfort food.

ingredients.item: Chopped herbs (such as sage, thyme, rosemary) (2 tablespoons)
Chicken or vegetable broth (1 to 1.5 cups)
Optional: cooked sausage, cranberries, nuts (to taste)

steps: In a large skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Add chopped onion and celery; cook until softened.
Stir in chopped herbs, salt, and pepper.
In a large mixing bowl, combine bread cubes with the sautéed vegetables and herbs.
Gradually add broth until the mixture is moist but not soggy.
Transfer the mixture to a greased baking dish.
Bake uncovered for 30-40 minutes until golden brown on top.
notes:
Feel free to add cooked sausage, cranberries, or nuts for extra flavor.
